latest_release.name: Kiri 0.2.1
latest_release.body:
## New
- **Pick your language from a short, searchable list.** Type a name in any script, or "farsi", "castellano", "हिंदी". It's the first thing Kiri asks, also in Windows setup, and it's in Settings › Appearance.
- **Kiri in 38 languages,** with Arabic, its first right-to-left language, and Amharic, its first Ethiopian one.
- **Pull from GitHub and Amazon ECR,** signing in through each registry's own page.
- **Select and copy a container's logs.**
- **A USB device that drops off and comes back is attached again.** Devices Kiri waits for show as waiting, in the window and in `kiri usb ls`, and Stop waiting lets them go.

## Fixed and improved
- **Testcontainers works.** Kiri reports a Docker engine version, so tools that check it start, and images run their own command when a client sends none. `docker version` shows Kiri's own version as the Kiri component.
- **Start and Stop no longer race.** Stopping Kiri right after starting it stops every container, and Stop with many containers takes seconds, not a minute or more.
- **`unless-stopped` and `always` containers come back** after Kiri is stopped and started again.
- **A command that can't run exits as on Docker:** 126, 127 or 255, with Docker's message.
- **Mac: `/etc` paths work in bind mounts, and a linked folder follows its link,** also after you point the link somewhere else and restart.
- **Disconnecting a container from its networks works in any order,** and the network can be removed after.
- **A stop wins over a pending restart,** and Docker hears a container is stopped only once it really is.
- **The Linux VM card shows the engine's real state** and fits the sidebar in every language.
- **A language picked in Settings changes the whole window at once.**
- **"Port already allocated" names the program that has the port.**
- **Linux: stopping the engine removes its bridges and firewall rules.**
- **The terminal keeps the size you give it,** and `kiri` on the PATH finds the VM's kernel.

---
Downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux: https://runkiri.com/releases/

detail.readme:
A tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

Download · Features · Build from source · Releases

🇬🇧 🇮🇩 🇩🇪 🇪🇸 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 🇵🇱 🇧🇷 🇻🇳 🇹🇷 🇷🇺 🇸🇦 🇯🇵 🇰🇷 🇨🇳 🇹🇼
Kiri speaks 38 languages. Is yours one?

--- Kiri is a lightweight replacement for Docker Desktop and OrbStack, written in Rust. It runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work. The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small". ## Why Kiri - **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. That's around 80 times faster than Docker Desktop. - **Light**: the VM sleeps after 60 s idle, the daemon stays at about 15 MB, and it wakes in about 0.15 s. - **Compatible**: `docker`, Compose, buildx, `docker login` and amd64 images through Rosetta. - **Local domains**: `http://.kiri.local`, with HTTPS from Kiri's own certificate authority. - **More than containers**: a one-command Kubernetes cluster and Linux machines. - **A native window** for containers, images, volumes and networks, plus a menu bar item. - **In your language**: 38 languages, on macOS, Windows and Linux alike. ### In your language Kiri's window and setup come in these languages. It follows your system's language, and you can change it in Settings → Appearance. In Arabic, Persian and Central Kurdish the whole window reads right to left. | | Language | | Language | | Language | | Language | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 🇬🇧 | English | 🇳🇴 | Norsk bokmål | 🇧🇬 | Български | 🇮🇳 | తెలుగు | | 🇮🇩 | Bahasa Indonesia | 🇵🇱 | Polski | 🇷🇺 | Русский | 🇹🇭 | ไทย | | 🇦🇩 | Català | 🇧🇷 | Português (Brasil) | 🇺🇦 | Українська | 🇱🇦 | ລາວ | | 🇨🇿 | Čeština | 🇷🇴 | Română | 🇰🇿 | Қазақша | 🇯🇵 | 日本語 | | 🇩🇪 | Deutsch | 🇦🇱 | Shqip | 🇸🇦 | العربية | 🇰🇷 | 한국어 | | 🇪🇸 | Español | 🇸🇮 | Slovenščina | 🇮🇷 | فارسی | 🇨🇳 | 简体中文 | | 🇫🇷 | Français | 🇫🇮 | Suomi | 🇮🇶 | کوردیی ناوەندی | 🇹🇼 | 繁體中文 | | 🇮🇹 | Italiano | 🇻🇳 | Tiếng Việt | 🇮🇳 | हिन्दी | 🇪🇹 | አማርኛ | | 🇱🇹 | Lietuvių | 🇹🇷 | Türkçe | 🇧🇩 | বাংলা | | | | 🇭🇺 | Magyar | 🇬🇷 | Ελληνικά | 🇮🇳 | தமிழ் | | | Missing yours? Translations live in [`crates/kiri/src/ui/lang`](crates/kiri/src/ui/lang); see [Contributing](#contributing). ## Install | Platform | Get it | |----------|--------| | macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel) | `.dmg` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Windows 10 and 11 (x86-64 or Arm, through WSL 2) | `.msi` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) | `.deb` or `.rpm` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | The first time you open Kiri, it sets up a `kiri` Docker context. Kiri updates itself, and checks each new release's signature first. ## Quick start ```sh docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello docker --context kiri compose up -d kiri k8s start # single-node Kubernetes as the `kiri` kubectl context kiri machine create dev --distro ubuntu && kiri machine shell dev kiri import # bring images, volumes and containers over from OrbStack or Docker Desktop ``` Docker's commands also work as `kiri` commands (`kiri run`, `kiri ps`, `kiri compose up`, and so on), and always target Kiri. ## Numbers `alpine` running `true` and removed, median of 30 runs, same `docker` CLI for all three: | | Docker Engine API | `docker` CLI | |----------------|------------------:|-------------:| | **Kiri** | **2.55 ms** | **14.2 ms** | | Docker Desktop | 213 ms | 243 ms | | OrbStack | 380 ms | 442 ms | Method and every other figure are in [`bench/results.json`](bench/results.json). Rerun with `kiri bench`. ## How it works ``` docker CLI ─┐ compose ────┼─ Docker Engine API ─► kiri daemon ── vsock ──► guest agent (PID 1) buildx ─────┤ owns the VM clone3 → container kiri UI ────┘ ``` The VM uses a custom 10 MB kernel, and its PID 1 is a ~900 KB Rust agent. That agent starts containers with a single `clone3` into namespaces and a cgroup. There's no runc, no shim and no dockerd. More detail is in [docs/development.md](docs/development.md#architecture). ## Documentation - [Features](docs/features.md): everything supported today, release files and known issues - [Development](docs/development.md): building, running from source, architecture and repository layout - [Release notes](docs/releases) ## Roadmap Next is a built-in builder. Kiri will serve Docker's own build endpoints, so buildx uses its docker driver against Kiri as it does against Docker Desktop. This brings `host-gateway` support to BuildKit builds, and images load straight into Kiri. ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). To report a vulnerability privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Third-party licences are in [NOTICE](NOTICE). The guest kernel is Linux (GPL-2.0); its config, patches and the source offer are in [`guest/kernel`](guest/kernel). The name "Kiri" and the Kiri logo are not covered by the licence. Forks are welcome, under a different name and logo.
